profile.headline: Software Engineer at Philadelphia Energy Solutions, LLC

positions.title: Software Engineer and Data Analyst
positions.description:
Manipulated data using SQL, Python, and bash in large databases.
Analyzed and calculated data to generate accurate reports for customers.
Maintained effective communication with team members to complete projects within time and budget restrictions.

positions.title: Assistant Computer/Phone/Electronics Technician
positions.description:

Troubleshoot wide range of electronic devices for swift assessment and repair
Manage billing and invoices; promote upgrades and products

positions.description: Routine computer maintenance, software installation, hardware installation, inventory, networking, technology configuration and set-up, assistant supervisor
